name: @mistral/common
//scripts: The upstream scripts (pnpm -w …, mtsc, vitest) belong to the monorepo this package was vendored out of and cannot run here; they are dropped so nx does not pick this workspace member up as a build/test target.
//dependencies: Vendored out of the upstream monorepo: the upstream `catalog:` protocol is meaningless here, so every specifier is concrete. Versions match the root package.json catalog where it has an entry (zod), otherwise the upstream catalog entry this release resolved against. `ajv`, `ajv-formats` and `@standard-schema/spec` arrived with `src/utils/validate-json-schema.ts` in the 64.x sources and are still there in 86.1.0; nothing `@mistralai/ui` imports reaches that module, but the copy is a faithful mirror and a mirror that does not install is worse than an unused edge.
